capabilities.validation: Compare with the Mie sphere benchmark, repeat with mesh refinement and check the extinction balance.

capabilities.validation: Compare with the cylindrical scattering benchmark, repeat with mesh refinement and check the extinction balance.

capabilities.scope: Use DOLFINx assembly and SciPy sparse matrix conversion with an external PyAMG solver for Poisson and linearized elasticity. Requires compatible sparse-array and PyAMG versions. For elasticity, configure rigid-body candidates when using near-nullspace information.

documentation.scope: The documented examples solve Poisson and linearized elasticity using PyAMG on DOLFINx-built operators.

capabilities.validation: Compare against a direct solve on a reduced case, and record independent relative residual and scaling.

capabilities.scope: Construct VTK connectivity and point/cell payload for supported meshes or degree-of-freedom spaces and visualize with external PyVista. User selects scalar or vector projection and handles complex field component and display sampling.

capabilities.validation: Check cell/point counts, coordinates and known field values in the supplied VTK arrays.

capabilities.scope: Select a compatible mesh geometry, form, discrete function and solver scalar dtype in the demonstrated Poisson case. Backend support controls viable real and complex combinations. A user-selected precision needs its own error threshold and tolerance.

documentation.scope: The tagged script solves Poisson with float32, float64, complex64 and complex128 where supported.

capabilities.validation: Compare error and residual for each supported dtype; verify field arrays and assembled operator dtypes.

capabilities.scope: Finite-deformation compressible neo-Hookean solid equilibrium using displacement only, the documented logarithmic-J strain energy, reference body force and traction. Strict incompressibility (J=1) with mixed displacement-pressure is not implemented by this demo and requires a custom stable mixed formulation, pressure gauge/constraints and independent verification. Temperature-dependent constitutive response and thermoelastic coupling are not demonstrated; they require a custom thermal field, constitutive law and transfer. Near-incompressible displacement-only performance and locking are not established. Define geometry, boundary conditions, material and nonlinear controls and validate each case.

documentation.scope: Fixed tag hyperelasticity.py defines compressible neo-Hookean strain energy and Cauchy stress. Main.cpp assembles the residual and tangent for the Newton solve and exports Cauchy stress.

capabilities.validation: Verify tangent consistency and load–displacement response against a large-strain benchmark; separately check volume change, mesh convergence and locking near incompressibility. Strictly incompressible or thermoelastic extensions require independent formulation and benchmark evidence.

couplings.quantity: temperature field and material thermal response
couplings.transfer: A compatible temperature field must be provided and included in the constitutive weak form.
couplings.custom_work: Specify thermal expansion or temperature-dependent energy, reference temperature, transfer/interpolation and validation; the cited hyperelastic demo does not implement thermal coupling.

capabilities.scope: Manually supply an affine-triangle P1 mass-matrix and load kernel, assemble into DOLFINx CSR and vector data structures, then accumulate ghost contributions. Custom kernels, mesh Jacobian convention, basis ordering and orientation for other elements require independent implementation.

documentation.scope: Official C++ documentation lists the executable demo code for a hand-written P1 mass and RHS cell kernel.

capabilities.validation: Compare each assembled value with the same UFL mass and load forms, including shared entities on a partition.

capabilities.module: C++ codim-0 mixed mass assembly / EntityMap
capabilities.scope: Assemble quadrilateral P1 mass operator with trial space on a same-dimensional cell submesh and test space on the parent mesh. Integrate over marked cells on the parent using the submesh EntityMap. Custom couplings require their own variational forms and correct subdomain-to-space maps.

documentation.scope: Fixed tag cpp/demo/codim_0_assembly/main.cpp creates marked quadrilateral submesh and EntityMap, and mixed_codim0.py defines the restricted parent-domain mass integral.

capabilities.validation: Compare the mixed matrix to the corresponding standalone submesh mass matrix after applying row/entity mappings, including shared-facet MPI ownership.
